title: The Language of Liars
description: Speak another person’s language. Know them. Become them. And discover you’ve destroyed them.In his training as a spy, Ro was warned: you will always be living a lie.Jumping into a Star Eater’s mind in the first place requires a moment of perfect psychic connection, and he has studied all his life to comprehend their species.
